codeReview.summary: APPSIM-002 implementation successfully boots the iPhone 17 Pro simulator, verifies device runtime availability (iOS 26.4), and produces all required JSON artifacts. The implementation uses XcodeBuildMCP boot_sim to boot the target simulator and list_sims to verify the booted state. The ios_app_harness.c test harness was updated to include the required 'status' field in boot_status.json. All 4 required artifacts (simulator_target.json, device_runtime.json, boot_status.json, report.json) are correctly produced and validated against the expected.yaml schema. The implementation fulfills validation assertions VAL-APPSIM-006 (Simulator Boot) and VAL-APPSIM-007 (Simulator Device Runtime).

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker correctly followed the AGENTS.md convention of using XcodeBuildMCP tools directly rather than xcodebuild or simctl CLI commands. All simulator operations used XcodeBuildMCP boot_sim and list_sims as documented.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff verification commands show: 'XcodeBuildMCP boot_sim' and 'XcodeBuildMCP list_sims --enabled' were used, matching AGENTS.md 'XcodeBuildMCP Operations' section.

sharedStateObservations.observation: services.yaml correctly documents the simulator configuration with simulator_id, project_path, scheme, and bundle_id. This was referenced by the worker during implementation.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: services.yaml at .factory/services.yaml contains xcodebuildmcp section with simulator_id: E6186E89-8784-473B-A4E4-66E42693F14E which matches the device_id in simulator_target.json.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker skill 'worker' was specified in features.json but did not exist in the system. Worker fell back to mission-worker-base skill which provided sufficient guidance. This is consistent with the skillFeedback in the handoff.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff skillFeedback.followedProcedure is true with no deviations reported for APPSIM-002. The transcript shows skill invocation succeeded, and the worker proceeded using available skills.
